detail.longDescription: I'm trying to set a conditional formatting based on an expression to mark certain cells with grey, italic font. I have tried dxf = DifferentialStyle(font=Font(color='FFD9D9DB', italic=True)) newrule = Rule(type="expression", dxf=dxf, stopIfTrue=False, priority=7) # Set priority to an unused int or behavior will be wonky newrule.formula = ['INDEX(Attributter!$1:$100000,XMATCH(E$5,INDEX(Attributter!$1:$100000,0,$C$3),0,1),XMATCH($B$3&"-"&$A6,Attributter!$3:$3,0,1))="<"'] templatesheet.conditional_formatting.add(sqref_sample, newrule) and newrule = FormulaRule(formula = ['INDEX(Attributter!$1:$100000,XMATCH(E$5,INDEX(Attributter!$1:$100000,0,$C$3),0,1),XMATCH($B$3&"-"&$A6,Attributter!$3:$3,0,1))="<"'], font=Font(italic=True, color='FFD9D9DB'), stopIfTrue=False) newrule.priority=7 templatesheet.conditional_formatting.add(sqref_sample, newrule) The rule inserts, but the rule doesn't "trigger" until I go into the conditional formatting in Excel, open the rule, and press "ok". I don't need to add the italic rule in there, pressing ok does the job. The priority is not used for other rules. I have also tried adding the rule with italic only (not editing the font color) with the same result. Any ideas to what goes wrong and how to fix it?
